title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Default rotation validated against full Job Bank detail pages. Scores measure technical and domain fit only; excluded-but-reviewed postings are scored 0 (out of scope) or -1 (ineligible) rows rather than a separate list.
latest_update: Re-read October 5, 2026 — the three default queries plus five extended occupation-code queries (Platform, DevSecOps, Infrastructure, Cloud DevOps, Systems Engineer Cloud) were run and every in-family result opened in full. Two strong-looking roles were excluded on arrangement: Vancouver on-site (Remarcable Senior DevOps) and a Montréal Azure Cloud Engineer needing 3 office days. 0 filed.

rows.title: DevOps/Cloud Engineer, Senior (RQ8)
rows.location: Toronto, ON — 3 days/week onsite (Metro Hall, 55 John St)
rows.gap: Real DevOps/cloud skill overlap (AWS/OpenShift, Linux, Docker/K8s, GitLab CI/CD), but Toronto is outside the reachable-city range (Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal) — hard geography gate regardless of the otherwise-decent rate.

rows.title: DevOps/Cloud Engineer, Senior (RQ4)
rows.location: Toronto, ON — 5 days/week onsite (87 Sir William Hearst Ave)
rows.gap: Toronto onsite 5 days/week is outside the reachable-city range — hard geography gate on its own. Separately, the actual required depth (WebLogic, WebSphere, Informatica, Mainframe IMS Connect, UNIX Solaris) is legacy enterprise-middleware administration, not the DevOps/cloud/platform work the title suggests — a real domain mismatch too.

rows.title: RQ11363 - DevOps/Cloud Engineer - Senior
rows.gap: New this run. Real AWS/Terraform/Ansible/OpenShift(ROSA)/GitLab-CI depth match, but Toronto onsite is outside the reachable-city range — hard geography gate regardless of skill fit.

rows.title: Senior ETL Engineer — Snowflake, data cloud, node.js
rows.gap: New this run, surfaced under the Cloud Engineer occupation code. Actual role is Snowflake/ETL data engineering (data pipelines, node.js), not infrastructure/DevOps/cloud-platform work — wrong domain center of gravity, same mislabeling pattern seen repeatedly on this board. Also Toronto onsite, outside the reachable-city range independently.

rows.title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevSecOps Engineer
rows.gap: Toronto hybrid is outside the reachable-city range regardless of cadence — hard geography gate. Independently, the role also requires 5+ years hands-on GCP as the primary cloud (Azure/AWS only "a plus") — hits the profile's hard AWS/GCP gate on its own.

rows.title: Cloud & AI Engineer
rows.gap: Real Platform/Cloud center of gravity (Azure/AWS Landing Zones, Terraform, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions), but 3+ days/week onsite in Montréal needs a rate well above target to offset the commute burden per the profile's geography rule — this rate sits at or below the $80/hr long-term survival floor instead, well short of "well above target." A different Lancesoft posting (Site Reliability Engineer, job ID 50107335) was already Skipped 2026-08-19 per applications.md — this is a distinct req at the same employer, not a duplicate.

rows.title: DevOps Engineer
rows.gap: London is outside the reachable-city range — hard geography gate. Also well below the $100k on-site/hybrid FTE salary floor, and scoped junior (2–4 years experience) regardless.

rows.title: OpenStack Cloud Engineer Consultant (Shared Services Canada)
rows.location: Ottawa, ON — SSC engagement, work arrangement not stated
rows.gap: Hands-on OpenStack at scale is the whole job — no OpenStack background, and a federal-contract placement that likely needs a security clearance

rows.title: DevOps Engineer (listed) — Engineering Specialist, Project Design
rows.gap: Mechanical/structural design engineer for air-supported structures — the DevOps title is an occupation-code label only

rows.title: Cloud Engineer
rows.gap: Same Toronto on-site client as the two Source Code postings already skipped; Toronto is outside the reachable cities

rows.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
rows.gap: AWS-required DevOps ownership at senior level, but the posting is on-site in Vancouver with no remote option

rows.title: Azure Cloud Engineer (AI platform infrastructure)
rows.location: Montréal, QC — hybrid, 3 days/week in office
rows.gap: Strong fit on skills (Azure APIM, Entra ID, Key Vault, Terraform, CI/CD, containers) but 3 office days a week needs a rate well above target and this sits at the Montréal floor

notes_sections.heading: October 5 full-read pass
items: Beyond the skill’s three default queries I ran Platform Engineer (0), DevSecOps Engineer (0), Infrastructure Engineer (2), Cloud DevOps (24) and Systems Engineer Cloud (25) and read the 44 unique results’ titles, then opened every plausible one in full: Remarcable Senior DevOps Engineer (AWS/Azure, $179,495, permanent) is on-site in Vancouver; Blitz TI Azure Cloud Engineer (Azure APIM, Entra ID, Key Vault, Terraform, containers, production AI platform; $120–140k permanent, 35 h/week) requires hybrid three days per week in downtown Montréal; CloudKettle’s “Cloud Architect” is a Salesforce Revenue Cloud architect; Lancesoft’s cloud developer is a Java full-stack role with 3 office days. The remaining results are cloud-developer, application-architect, network, mechanical and managerial roles.
Job Bank result and detail pages work by direct HTTP; the originating-site name appears on each detail page (Jobillico, ZipRecruiter, Talent.com, Indeed).

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Ran the default 3-query rotation only (DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer), per SKILL.md — Platform Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, and DevSecOps Engineer are deliberately excluded from the default rotation due to historically unrelated occupation-code matches.
Site Reliability Engineer returned zero results this run (persistent — 0 results across the last several runs).

DevOps Engineer returned 2 results, both known (LYNKED Inc., InfoTrack Canada, persisting from 2026-09-21). Cloud Engineer returned 5 results: 3 known (Lancesoft, Source Code RQ4, Source Code RQ8) plus 2 new — Source Code RQ11363 (a third distinct Source Code req, same employer as RQ4/RQ8, Toronto onsite, Ineligible) and Astra North Infoteck's "Senior ETL Engineer" (mislabeled under the Cloud Engineer occupation code — actual role is Snowflake/ETL data engineering, Out of scope).

All 7 plausible postings this run were opened and read in full via direct HTTP. 6 excluded on geography (all outside the Ottawa/Kingston/Brockville/Cornwall/Montréal reachable-city range, or Montréal at 3x/week onsite below the required rate premium); 1 excluded on domain (ETL/data engineering wearing a Cloud Engineer occupation code).
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred. All retrieval was read-only, via direct HTTP curl.
Nothing auto-filed — every reviewed row scored -1 or 0, below the automatic-filing policy's score >= 5 threshold.

method: Direct HTTP retrieval against jobbank.gc.ca's search and detail pages for the 3-query default rotation (locationstring=Remote, discovery-only, not proof of eligibility). 7 plausible postings opened and read in full via their Job Bank detail pages; 6 excluded on the geography gate (reachable-city range: Ottawa, Kingston, Brockville, Cornwall, Montréal) and scored -1/Ineligible, 1 excluded on domain mismatch and scored 0/Out of scope — all as rows per reports/report_schema.md, rather than a separate footer list. 0 eligible, 0 pipeline matches, 0 inaccessible, 0 auto-filed.
